### 10.1 Comprehensive Endocrine Pathology Matrix

| Endocrine Disorder | Gland & Specific Hormonal Defect | Clinical & Diagnostic Manifestations |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Pituitary Dwarfism** | **Hyposecretion of Growth Hormone (GH)** during childhood | Stunted physical growth with **proportionate body dimensions**; normal intelligence |
| **Gigantism** | **Hypersecretion of Growth Hormone (GH)** during childhood before epiphyseal plate fusion | Abnormal, excessive elongation of long bones; extreme tall stature |
| **Acromegaly** | **Hypersecretion of Growth Hormone (GH)** in adults after epiphyseal plate closure | Severe disfigurement featuring enlargement of facial bones (*lower jaw prognathism*), hands, and feet; hyper-visceromegaly; premature death |
| **Cretinism** | Severe **Hypothyroidism** during pregnancy / early infancy | Stunted physical growth, severe **Mental Retardation**, low IQ, deaf-mutism, bloated face, coarse dry skin, and protruding tongue |
| **Simple Endemic Goitre** | Dietary **Iodine Deficiency** leading to thyroid hypofunction | Compensatory hypertrophy and enlargement of the thyroid gland; low serum $T_3/T_4$ |
| **Myxedema (Gull's Disease)** | **Hypothyroidism** in adults | Low Basal Metabolic Rate (BMR), weight gain, lethargy, cold intolerance, mental dullness, and non-pitting subcutaneous edema |
| **Exophthalmic Goitre (Grave's Disease)** | **Autoimmune Hyperthyroidism**; auto-antibodies (**TSI**) stimulate TSH receptors continuously | Thyroid enlargement, markedly elevated BMR, weight loss, rapid heart rate, nervousness, and **Exophthalmos** (protruding eyeballs due to retro-orbital fluid accumulation) |
| **Addison's Disease** | **Hyposecretion of Adrenal Cortical Hormones** (Glucocorticoids & Mineralocorticoids) due to cortical destruction | Severe **Hypoglycemia**, hyponatremia, hyperkalemia, extreme muscle weakness, weight loss, low BP, and **bronze pigmentation of skin** |
| **Cushing's Syndrome** | **Hypersecretion of Cortisol** (Adrenal cortex tumor or excess ACTH) | Persistent **Hyperglycemia**, breakdown of muscle tissue, "Moon Face", "Buffalo Hump", abdominal obesity, hypertension, and osteoporosis |
| **Tetany** | **Hyposecretion of Parathyroid Hormone (PTH)** | Low serum $\text{Ca}^{2+}$ (hypocalcemia) causing involuntary, painful muscle spasms and cramps |

conceptBreakdown.heading: Prognathism & Visceromegaly in Acromegaly
conceptBreakdown.explanation: Because epiphyseal growth plates have already closed in adults, excess GH cannot lengthen long bones; instead, it stimulates periosteal bone apposition (enlarging mandible, brow ridges, hands) and soft tissue/visceral organ growth (cardiomegaly, macroglossia).

conceptBreakdown.heading: Hyperpigmentation Mechanism in Addison's Disease
conceptBreakdown.explanation: Destruction of the adrenal cortex removes negative feedback inhibition, prompting massive hypothalamic CRH and pituitary POMC (Pro-opiomelanocortin) synthesis. Cleavage of POMC produces both ACTH and MSH (Melanocyte-Stimulating Hormone), causing generalized bronze skin hyperpigmentation.
